title: Biallelic Loss of Function Variants in Myocardial Zonula Adherens Protein Gene (MYZAP) Cause a Severe Recessive Form of Dilated Cardiomyopathy

reviewer.method: Entire three-page research letter read in fresh pdftotext -layout extraction, including full methods, family descriptions, disclosures and all five references. patient_identity.statement: 35-year-old proband II.2 matches the family narrative and pedigree; she is a distinct subject from her affected sister.

genotype.statement: Both sisters carry the reported NM_001018100.5:c.349C>T/p.Arg117* and c.933+1G>A variants in compound heterozygosity. Coding HGVS, protein consequence where specified, and two heterozygous states agree with the packet.
limitations: The article does not print the packet GRCh38 genomic coordinates or VCF alleles; this review has not independently remapped them or re-called raw exomes. The splice protein consequence remains unspecified in the packet.

segregation.statement: Figure A assigns the splice-site variant E1 to the unaffected father (62 years) and p.Arg117* E2 to the unaffected mother (60 years); both affected daughters have both variants.

phase.statement: Different parental origins support trans configuration, explicitly stated as compound heterozygosity in the article.
limitations: Original segregation reads/traces were not supplied.

causal_confidence.statement: The recessive family segregation, prior independent homozygous report cited by the authors, reduced skin signal in both sisters, and altered HL-1 expression/localization support MYZAP as a recessive DCM candidate. Neither a published functional observation nor a source gene label independently proves clinical causality.
limitations: The article describes lower splice-construct abundance as degradation, but a steady-state blot alone does not measure degradation kinetics. Exact construct/splice-transcript characterization is not supplied in this letter.
Arg117* protein delocalization is observed; absence of every protein function is not directly measured. This is not N1002K/BubR1 or drug-rescue evidence.
Population heterozygote analysis does not establish absolute absence of cardiac risk.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All 8 packet features compared with the narrative and figure. Proband ventricular ectopy is explicit, but the ventricular-tachycardia passage refers to the younger sister, so proband VT cannot be confirmed.
limitations: An unreported feature is not an observed negative. EF-category mappings and onset timing are interpretive; raw values are retained below.

assessment.statement: 35-year-old proband II.2 has LV dilatation and systolic dysfunction, diagnosed as DCM.
Proband Holter shows frequent ventricular ectopic beats, 1000 per 24 hours.
Cardiac MRI shows biventricular midventricular fibrosis, predominantly LV in the proband and a similar pattern in the sister; Figure A shows both subjects.
The explicit nonsustained VT, ICD and subsequent sustained VT/shock sentences follow the younger-sister description. No sentence establishes VT specifically in the proband.
limitations: This may be a sibling-attribution error; the source does not explicitly say the proband has never had VT, so this is unresolved rather than contradicted.

This is a post-inference source-correspondence review with prior aggregate-result exposure; it does not establish independent clinical truth or diagnostic accuracy.
No supplemental files are listed/distributed. Underlying patient and laboratory data are available only on reasonable author request; they were not obtained and no external contact was made.

The population paragraph prints 1420/15552 as 8.4%, whereas the arithmetic is approximately 9.13%. Its reported odds ratio is retained as a source claim, not independently reproduced from these inconsistent denominators.

The text attributes zebrafish functional findings to reference 3, whose printed title is a mouse cardiac-overexpression study; this citation mismatch is retained as an unresolved source inconsistency.
Full reading and packet adjudication do not certify every paper claim. Unsupported phenotype fields remain unresolved without altering the frozen cohort.
